title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Blueberry Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Blueberry Sour Raspberry delivers a bold blend of sweet blueberries and tangy raspberries with a sharp, sour twist for a perfectly balanced vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, offering extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Featuring advanced dual mesh coil technology, the pods provide consistently smooth vapour and enhanced flavour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design ensure that refilling is quick and simple, making it a mess-free, user-friendly option. Together, the pod and refill container deliver up to 6000 puffs, offering a long-lasting, satisfying vaping experience. With 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods deliver a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making them ideal for both seasoned and newer adult vapers. Once the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them for an effortless and uninterrupted vaping experience.
